lines.zh: 我一蹦一蹦，后腿弹得很快。
lines.en: I bound along, hind legs springing fast.
A trail of little pits follows me.
I stop and twitch my nose.
My ears move before I do.
I hop over a low clump of grass.

lines.zh: 我沿着田埂走，避开空地。
lines.en: I keep to the field edge, away from open ground.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，我跨过了小水沟。
lines.en: A kick of my hind legs clears the little ditch.

lines.zh: 尾巴后面一团白毛在抖。
lines.en: The white tuft of my tail bobs behind me.

lines.zh: 我绕开一块石头，继续走。
lines.en: I skirt a stone and keep going.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，专挑矮草走。
lines.en: In short hops, I keep to the low grass.
I walk and chew at the same time.
Grass tips brush my face.
I hop up a bank and slide down.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向，风从背后吹。
lines.en: I turn so the wind is at my back.
I pause, whiskers working.
I slip through the gap in the fence.

lines.zh: 我坐着，两只前爪垂在胸前。
lines.en: I sit with my forepaws hanging.
I look up and watch the clouds.
I'm chewing a grass stem.

lines.zh: 风吹过，我背上的白毛立起来。
lines.en: Wind passes and the white fur on my back lifts.

lines.zh: 我竖起一只耳朵，又放下。
lines.en: One ear up, then down.
I sniff; nothing interesting.
I lick a paw and wash my face.
I tuck into a ball over my tail.

lines.zh: 我挑最嫩的叶尖，慢慢磨牙。
lines.en: I pick the tenderest tips and chew them slowly.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，鼻子有点痒。
lines.en: I sneeze; my nose tickles.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处的一片叶子。
lines.en: I stare at a leaf in the distance.
I have no plans to leave.

lines.zh: 地面有点凉，我换了只脚。
lines.en: The ground is cold; I shift my feet.
I close one eye, then open it.

lines.zh: 我趴着，看一只蚂蚁翻过石子。
lines.en: I lie still, watching an ant cross a pebble.
I slowly finish the last bite.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，耳朵直直朝你。
lines.en: I look up, ears pointing straight at you.

lines.zh: 再近半步，我就钻回草里。
lines.en: Half a step closer and I'm back in the grass.

lines.zh: 我把胡须翘起来，闻你的鞋。
lines.en: I lift my whiskers and sniff your shoes.

lines.zh: 我在看你脚边有没有吃的。
lines.en: I'm checking your feet for food.

lines.zh: 我盯住你，耳朵却朝别处歪着。
lines.en: I watch you while one ear points elsewhere.
I edge back half a step.

lines.zh: 你的影子一挪，我的耳朵就抖。
lines.en: When your shadow shifts, my ears twitch.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，打量你的靴子。
lines.en: Head tilted, I inspect your boots.

lines.zh: 我是有雀斑的那只，别认错。
lines.en: I'm the freckled one. Don't mix me up.
Reach for me and I run.
I flatten my ears against my back.
I watch you, waiting for the next move.
I leap with the pain.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，耳朵贴着背。
lines.en: I curl up, ears flat.
That sends me rolling.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，蹿进了灌木。
lines.en: I let out a yelp and dart into the bushes.
My hind legs tremble.
I lick the sore spot.
There's blood in my fur.
I can still hop, just slower.

lines.zh: 我抽着气，耳朵贴得死紧。
lines.en: I gasp, ears pinned flat to my back.
I want to hide back in the grass.
Is that carrot I smell?
My nose twitches rapidly.

lines.zh: 你手里那根，看起来不错。
lines.en: That one in your hand looks good.

lines.zh: 我伸着鼻子，一点点凑过去。
lines.en: Nose first, I creep over bit by bit.
Don't throw it far; I won't chase.
I'll eat, but don't touch me.

lines.zh: 这味道能让我忘掉危险。
lines.en: That smell makes me forget danger.

lines.zh: 你把手放低，我才肯挪过去。
lines.en: Lower your hand and only then will I move.
I stretch my neck to reach it.
That's one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我嚼得很快，腮帮子鼓起来。
lines.en: I chew fast, cheeks bulging.
Got more? I'm still hungry.
This clump tastes better than your hand.

lines.zh: 我从你指缝里叼走一根。
lines.en: I snatch a piece from between your fingers.
I back off two steps to eat.
Move once and I'm gone.
You bump me and I spring aside.
I'm small; the bump barely hurts.
I jump in fright.
The bump flattens my ears.
I land in a roll.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩偏，我滚了半圈。
lines.en: Your foot lands wide; I roll half a turn.
I dart past your feet and away.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的毛弄乱了。
lines.en: That mussed my fur.

lines.zh: 我抖掉毛上的土，才站稳。
lines.en: I shake the dirt off my fur before I stand.
Watch where you walk next time.
I've found a companion in the grass.
We touch noses and sniff.
It hops half a circle around me.
I follow it into the bushes.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，毛都乱了。
lines.en: We press together, fur all mussed.
There's grass enough for us both.
It runs; I chase.
We stop behind a mound.
Then it leaves first.
I stay and chew grass slowly.
I pick up a leaf.
I hold it in my forepaws and nibble.
Too tough; I can't bite it.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，倒退着钻进草。
lines.en: Holding it, I back into the grass.
I dropped it; I'll get it again.
Too heavy to carry, so I drag it.

lines.zh: 这东西扎嘴，我吐出来看看。
lines.en: It pricks my mouth; I spit it out to look.
I tuck it under a stone.

lines.zh: 我先刨个坑，把它埋进去。
lines.en: I dig a hole first and bury it.
I sniff before deciding to take it.

lines.zh: 草里响了一声，我抬起头。
lines.en: A rustle in the grass; I look up.
I stand both ears straight up.

lines.zh: 灌木那边窸窣一声，我伏低。
lines.en: A rustle from the bush; I flatten myself.

lines.zh: 耳朵先定住，我再决定跑不跑。
lines.en: My ears lock first, then I decide whether to bolt.
Get a look first, then decide to run.
It doesn't look like a fox.
I edge back a little.
I thump the ground with a hind foot.
That's a warning. Don't come closer.
I can bolt at any moment.
It's still there. I hold still.
I flatten down, trying to disappear.
When it turns its head, I shift one step.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵能听见它的呼吸。
lines.en: I can hear it breathe.

lines.zh: 风带来它的气味，我先闻清了。
lines.en: The wind carries its scent; I read it first.
I ease back behind the bush.

lines.zh: 我贴着土埂，连胡须都不动。
lines.en: Pressed to the ridge, I don't even twitch a whisker.
I'll wait for it to leave.
One step closer and I run.
My heart is beating fast.
I kick out with my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我蹬了一下，够你记住了。
lines.en: One kick, and that's enough for you to remember.

lines.zh: 我咬住就松口，牙太钝了。
lines.en: I bite and let go at once; my teeth are too blunt.

lines.zh: 我撞完它，头也不回地跑。
lines.en: I ram it once and run without looking back.

lines.zh: 我后爪扫过去，只刮到空气。
lines.en: My hind claws sweep through empty air.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，蹬在它鼻子上。
lines.en: I leap and kick its nose.
It pulls back; I turn and bolt.
I'm not built for fighting.
Running is more reliable.
I dive into the grass and vanish.
I come out of my grass nest.

lines.zh: 背上的雀斑在阳光里很明显。
lines.en: My freckles show clearly in the sun.
I shake my ears.

lines.zh: 这片草地闻起来很新鲜。
lines.en: This meadow smells fresh.
First I find a mound.

lines.zh: 我从土洞探出半个脑袋。
lines.en: I poke half a head out of my burrow.
I sniff all around.

lines.zh: 田埂尽头，我听见两个人的脚步。
lines.en: At the end of the path I hear two pairs of feet.
I sit and groom my fur.
The smells here are unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 毛烧焦了一块，我拼命跑。
lines.en: My fur singes; I run hard.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，腿折了一下。
lines.en: I hit the ground and my leg folds.

lines.zh: 水没过耳朵，我拼命往岸上刨。
lines.en: Water closes over my ears; I claw for the bank.

lines.zh: 我被掀翻，落地时滚了三圈。
lines.en: I'm blown over and roll three times on landing.

lines.zh: 箭尖挑开我的毛，留了道痕。
lines.en: An arrowhead parts my fur and leaves a line.

lines.zh: 紫色的光裹住我，毛都竖起来。
lines.en: Violet light wraps me and my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 我把草根啃光了，腿有点软。
lines.en: I've chewed the roots bare, and my legs feel weak.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整只都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I go rigid.
No ground; I keep falling.
